messages.author: ff6db0dca91af59a
messages.subject: time series of > 1 lines with error bars for each line
parts:
Would someone please help me with this? The data is temperatures for
three lake depths accumulated over 4 years. I put each the data into
the 15th of each month. I am working with the text 'ggplot2' by
Hadley Wickham. I want to

1. plot the means of each month with error bars
1. write the x label in %b (Jan, Jun, etc.) format only to remove the
fake year
3. adjust the position of each label to be under the data and trim the
ends if necessary (zoom)

For the date format and zoom I have been trying the example on page
101 without success (e.g., "wrong sign").

For the error bars I have only been able to add them to a plot of a
single line, and they are lacking the horizontal part. For one of my
tries I gave the months numbers to call months a continuous variable.
Beautiful error bars and smooths but I couldn't add other lines with
their own stat summaries.

Your help will be greatfully appreciated! Thank you in advance.

I place the minidate.csv in the file holder of this wesbite.

it is at:
http://ggplot2.googlegroups.com/web/minidate.csv?gsc=vbqLjwsAAADqd9F2jwYru_5JW7FLitAs

Thank you again...
Here's what I've got so far:

# require ggplot2

aa<-ggplot(minidate, aes(Month)) +
geom_line(aes(y = X1mbs, colour = "1mbs")) +
geom_line(aes(y = X15mbs, colour = "15mbs")) +
geom_line(aes(y = X50mbs, colour = "50mbs")) +
scale_colour_hue("Depth
")

# axis titles and lose non-data parts

aa + labs(y = "Water Temperature (ºC)
", x=NULL)

last_plot() + opts(panel.grid.minor = theme_blank())
last_plot() + opts(panel.grid.major = theme_blank())
last_plot() + opts(panel.background = theme_blank())
last_plot() +
opts(axis.title.x = theme_blank())
last_plot() + opts(axis.line = theme_segment())

Anthony Jagger

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: time series of > 1 lines with error bars for each line
parts:
Hi Antony,

Is this what you are looking for?

library(ggplot2)

minidate <- read.csv("minidate.csv")
minidatem <- melt(minidate, id = "Month")

date <- paste("01-", minidatem$Month, sep = "")
minidatem$date <- as.POSIXct(strptime(date, "%d-%b-%y"))

ggplot(minidatem, aes(date, value, colour = variable)) +
stat_summary(geom = "line", fun.y = "mean") +
stat_summary(geom = "linerange", fun.ymin = "min", fun.ymax = "max")


Hadley

messages.subject: Re: time series of > 1 lines with error bars for each line
parts:
sorry - would you please show how to have only month (Jan, Feb)
without the year? The values are accumulated over several years.

library(ggplot2)

minidatem <- melt(minidate, id = "Month")
date <- paste("01-", minidatem$Month, sep = "")
minidatem$date <- as.POSIXct(strptime(date, "%d-%b-%y"))

aa <- aa + labs(y = "Water Temperature (ºC)", x=NULL)

aa <- aa + opts(panel.grid.minor = theme_blank()) + opts
(panel.grid.major = theme_blank()) +
opts(panel.background = theme_blank()) + opts(axis.title.x =
theme_blank()) +
opts(axis.line = theme_segment())

aa


Thank you

Ant.
